entry.question:
## Physical scenario

The truck in figure is moving at a speed of \(10.0 \, \text{m/s}\) relative to the ground. The person on the truck throws a baseball in the backward direction at a speed of \(20.0 \, \text{m/s}\) relative to the truck.

## Question

What is the velocity of the baseball as measured by the observer on the ground?

## Answer choices

- A: A: \(30.0 \

- B: B: \(20.0 \

- C: C: \(-30.0 \

- D: D: \(-10.0 \

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a scene involving a gray pickup truck with a person standing in its bed who is throwing a ball. The truck is moving to the right. There are two velocity vectors labeled: one for the ball (\(\overrightarrow{v}\)) pointing to the left, and one for the truck (\(\overrightarrow{v}_{\text{truck}}\)) pointing to the right. 

The scene also includes a person kneeling on the ground behind the truck, observing the action. The ground is a flat surface on which the truck is positioned.

The image conveys the concept of relative motion, showing the contrast between the velocity of the ball and the truck.

## Dataset metadata

Relativity; Physical Model Grounding Reasoning, Spatial Relation Reasoning
